name: OpenMausBot
tagline: A local-first team of AI bots inside a chat app, with no tokens and no crypto
description: OpenMausBot is an open-source alternative to Grok Bot that runs an entire team of AI bots inside a chat app. It is local-first and bring-your-own-model, so both your data and your choice of LLM stay firmly under your control. True to its ethos, it explicitly ships with no tokens and carries an anti-crypto disclaimer — a rare stance in the current AI-agent wave. For anyone wary of cloud lock-in or token economies, it is a refreshingly grounded take on multi-agent chat.
highlights: A team of AI bots collaborating inside a single chat app
Explicitly no-token and anti-crypto by design
Positioned as an open-source alternative to Grok Bot
716 stars within days of its launch
curatorNote: In a batch full of token-driven agent products, OpenMausBot stands out by refusing the token economy entirely — local-first, bring-your-own-model, and proudly no-crypto. Worth a look for what honest multi-agent chat can look like.
